    Cyclic endomorphism monoids (ray category axiom (d)) #

    EndCyclic P: at each object the non-invertible endomorphisms are the positive powers of one endomorphism π(x). This holds for the ray category of a split basic distributive algebra (SplitBasicData.endCyclic), with π(x) the ray of a radical parameter (OrientedRadicalPowerParameter).
